message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the CSV files, image data, or config values before use; np.nan_to_num replaces NaNs but is not a validation control.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded directly from local file paths and CSV files with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks; no remote sources are accessed in this code.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label distributions, checking of expected label values, or use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code only applies normalization and NaN-to-num replacement for numerical stability; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses torchvision.models.resnet50(pretrained=False) and pdresnet50(pretrained=False), so no pretrained weights are loaded at all, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision for any model artifact.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or expected label set before or during training; the dataset is loaded and used directly without any validation.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense implemented anywhere in the training pipeline.

No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used; the standard PyTorch Lightning trainer is used without any DP mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test split exists, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no held-out isolation enforcement, and metric logging calls are commented out, providing no meaningful tamper protection.

No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape, range, or schema validation checks on incoming data before it is passed to the model; np.nan_to_num handles NaNs in preprocessing but is not a defensive input validation control.
No detected output bounds checks: The model outputs are used directly in loss and accuracy calculations without any bounds checking, NaN guards, or sanity checks on the predicted values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision-based Siamese network pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
